description: A coiled white charging cable and a pink phone-like device lie on a dark blue bedspread in front of a pale pillow. The right hand slides in from the right, grips the pink device as a right-hand object, and pulls it slightly rightward while the left hand reaches toward the cable; then the left hand lifts the cable’s plug and pulls it free, unplugging it from the device as the right hand moves the device farther away and sets it down near the pillow.
